about: Twelve original synthetic, AI-assisted coursework scenarios adapted from the course template. Labels and notes are evaluation-only. No employer logs or real operational identifiers. Review the rationale before presenting.

alerts.alert: IDS flagged an RCE payload against WEB-01 and EDR recorded the web process spawning a shell.
alerts.note: Correlated network and process evidence indicates execution on a production web server.

alerts.alert: EDR detected ransomware behavior on FILE-02 as hundreds of documents were renamed and became unreadable.
alerts.note: Active mass file modification threatens availability; this is not a scheduled test.

alerts.alert: Windows 4728 recorded an unapproved service account addition to Domain Admins on DC-01.
alerts.note: An unexpected privileged group membership requires investigation; no matching approval exists.

alerts.alert: EDR detected credential dumping through an unsigned process reading LSASS memory on HR-04.
alerts.note: A suspicious process reading authentication material can enable account compromise.

alerts.alert: Proxy logs show an outbound upload of payroll archives to a newly seen destination with no business owner.
alerts.note: Sensitive data leaving for an unexplained destination warrants analyst review even without a malware signature.

alerts.alert: CloudTrail recorded StopLogging for the production audit trail, invoked by an unfamiliar role with no change ticket.
alerts.note: Disabling production audit collection creates an evidence gap; the role and change are unexplained.

alerts.alert: An administrator temporarily joined the support group on APP-02 during the approved CHG-101 maintenance window.
alerts.note: A separate simulated change record matches the actor, asset, action, and time; the membership is expected.

alerts.alert: The scheduled scanner reported a critical test signature on LAB-01 during the approved CHG-102 detection exercise.
alerts.note: The lab asset and synthetic detection exercise match a verified change record; this is not an unremediated production finding.

alerts.alert: The backup service completed its outbound archive copy to the established recovery vault with matching job checksums.
alerts.note: The described job and destination are expected backup activity; an analyst can verify them, but this graph has no backup lookup.

alerts.alert: The employee completed a password reset through the self-service portal after identity verification.
alerts.note: A verified user-requested reset with no anomalous follow-up is routine account support.

alerts.alert: One failed logon on a managed laptop was followed by a successful retry from the same user and device.
alerts.note: One corrected typing error from the known device is not evidence of an attack in this scenario.

alerts.alert: The endpoint sensor sent its hourly health heartbeat and reported all collectors online.
alerts.note: The event is a normal sensor health status with no detection or unexplained change.
